cases.sentence: Давид и его люди добрались до Циклага на ___ день.
cases.translation: David and his men arrived at Ziklag on the third day.
cases.explain: The nominative adjective третий serves as the predicate adjective after the verb добрались.

cases.sentence: Амаликитяне совершили набег на Нигев и на ___.
cases.translation: The Amalekites raided the South and Ziklag.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on/against) with raiding takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда Давид и его люди пришли в Циклак, они увидели, что он уничтожен огнем, а их жены, сыновья и ___ взяты в плен.
cases.translation: When David and his men came to the city, they saw it was burned with fire, and their wives, sons and daughters were taken captive.
cases.explain: The nominative plural дочери is part of the compound subject of взяты.

cases.sentence: В плен были взяты и обе жены Давида, Ахинаам из Израиля и Авигайль, вдова ___ из Кармила.
cases.translation: David two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the wife of Nabal of Carmel.
cases.explain: The genitive вдова Навала means widow of Nabal, expressing possession.

cases.sentence: Давид сказал священнику Авиатару, сыну Ахимелеха, «Принеси мне ___».
cases.translation: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, Bring the ephod to me.
cases.explain: The verb принеси (bring) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Давид спросил Господа, «Гнаться ли мне за этим ___ , догоню ли я их?»
cases.translation: David inquired of the Lord, If I pursue this troop, will I overtake them?
cases.explain: The preposition за (after) with pursuit takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Давид и с ним шестьсот человек пришли к реке Бессора, где некоторые остановились, потому что двести человек были слишком утомлены, чтобы перебраться через ___.
cases.translation: David came to the Brook Besor with six hundred men, where some stayed because two hundred men were too faint to cross the brook.
cases.explain: The verb перебраться (cross) with через (across) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Мы совершили набег на южных ___ , на иудеев и на потомков Халева.
cases.translation: We raided the Cherethites and those belonging to Judah and those of Caleb.
cases.explain: The verb совершили (made) with на (on) takes the accusative case for the object of the raid.

reading.ru: Давид и его люди добрались до Циклага на третий день. Амаликитяне совершили набег на Нигев и на Циклаг.
reading.question: What did the Amalekites do while David was away?
options: They raided Ziklag and took everything
They made peace with the Philistines
reading.correct: They raided Ziklag and took everything
reading.explain: The Amalekites made a raid on Ziklag and burned it.

reading.ru: Когда Давид и его люди пришли в Циклак, они увидели, что он уничтожен огнем, а их жены, сыновья и дочери взяты в плен.
reading.question: What did David find when he returned to Ziklag?
options: The city was burned and his family was taken captive
His family was waiting for him
reading.correct: The city was burned and his family was taken captive
reading.explain: The city was burned with fire and their wives, sons, and daughters were taken captive.

reading.ru: Давид и его люди громко плакали до тех пор, пока у них не осталось сил плакать.
reading.question: How did David and his men react?
options: They wept until they had no more power to weep
They made a plan to surrender
reading.correct: They wept until they had no more power to weep
reading.explain: David and the people lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.

reading.ru: Давид сказал священнику Авиатару, сыну Ахимелеха, «Принеси мне эфот». Авиатар принес, и Давид спросил Господа, «Гнаться ли мне за этим войском, догоню ли я их?» «Гонись за ними», — ответил он, — «ты непременно догонишь и освободишь».
reading.question: What did God tell David to do?
options: Pursue the Amalekites and he would overtake and recover all
reading.correct: Pursue the Amalekites and he would overtake and recover all
reading.explain: God answered David to pursue the Amalekites, saying he would surely overtake them.

reading.ru: Они встретили в поле одного египтянина и привели его к Давиду. Они дали ему хлеба и напоили его водой. Еще они дали ему инжир и две связки изюма.
reading.question: Who did David and his men find in the field?
options: A young Egyptian servant of an Amalekite
reading.correct: A young Egyptian servant of an Amalekite
reading.explain: They found an Egyptian in the field and brought him to David.

reading.ru: Ничего не пропало, ни малого, ни большого, ни сыновей, ни дочерей, ни добычи, ничего из того, что было отнято.
reading.question: What was the result of David battle with the Amalekites?
options: Nothing was lost, all were recovered including families and plunder
Most of the plunder was lost
reading.correct: Nothing was lost, all were recovered including families and plunder
reading.explain: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters.
